mapper.sql: SELECT b.bill_id,b.bill_stg_id,false AS virtual_plan,b.bill_no,b.prj_id, p.prj_nm AS project_name,p.cust_ptnr_id AS customer_id,c.ptnr_nm AS customer_name, p.cntrct_ty_cd AS contract_type,b.atrb_ym,b.bill_dt,b.sply_amt,b.vat_amt,b.tot_amt, b.bill_stts_cd,b.txinv_no,b.txinv_dt,b.rcpt_plan_dt, coalesce(r.amount,0)::bigint AS received_amt, (b.tot_amt+coalesce(a.amount,0))::bigint AS adjusted_total_amt, CASE WHEN b.bill_stts_cd='CONFIRM' AND b.amnd_yn='N' THEN greatest(0,b.tot_amt+coalesce(a.amount,0)-coalesce(r.amount,0)) ELSE 0 END::bigint AS receivable_amt, NULL::integer AS reminder_stage FROM bill.bill b JOIN prj.prj p ON p.prj_id=b.prj_id LEFT JOIN mst.ptnr c ON c.ptnr_id=p.cust_ptnr_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT sum(x.tot_amt) AS amount FROM bill.bill x WHERE x.orgnl_bill_id=b.bill_id AND x.bill_stts_cd='CONFIRM') a ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT sum(x.rcpt_amt) AS amount FROM bill.rcpt x WHERE x.bill_id=b.bill_id) r ON true
mapper.select: SELECT b.bill_id,b.orgnl_bill_id,b.amnd_yn,b.rmrk_desc AS reason FROM bill.bill b WHERE b.bill_id=#{id}

SELECT d.asgn_id,a.dev_id,d.cntrct_dev_id,v.dev_nm AS display_name,d.work_ym,d.mm_qty, m.mm_qty AS source_mm_qty,d.untprc_amt,d.work_day_qty,d.work_tm_qty,d.ovtm_tm_qty, d.ovtm_amt,d.bill_amt,d.rmrk_desc FROM bill.bill_dtl d LEFT JOIN asgn.asgn a ON a.asgn_id=d.asgn_id LEFT JOIN mst.dev v ON v.dev_id=coalesce(d.cntrct_dev_id,a.dev_id) LEFT JOIN asgn.asgn_mth m ON m.asgn_id=d.asgn_id AND m.work_ym=d.work_ym WHERE d.bill_id=#{id} ORDER BY d.bill_dtl_id
SELECT r.rcpt_id AS receipt_id,r.rcpt_dt,r.rcpt_amt,r.rmrk_desc FROM bill.rcpt r WHERE r.bill_id=#{id} ORDER BY r.rcpt_dt,r.rcpt_id

SELECT concat(h.clmn_nm,': ',h.bfr_val,' → ',h.aft_val,' ',h.rsn_desc) AS description, h.chg_at AS changed_at,h.chg_user_id::text AS user_id FROM sys.data_chg_hist h WHERE h.tbl_nm='bill.bill' AND h.obj_rec_id=#{id}::text ORDER BY h.chg_at,h.data_chg_hist_id
SELECT count(*) FROM bill.bill b WHERE b.orgnl_bill_id=#{id} AND b.bill_stts_cd='CONFIRM'
SELECT coalesce(sum(b.sply_amt),0)::bigint FROM bill.bill b WHERE b.orgnl_bill_id=#{id} AND b.bill_stts_cd='CONFIRM'
mapper.sql: SELECT p.prj_id AS project_id,p.prj_nm AS project_name,p.cntrct_ty_cd AS contract_type, p.stlm_mthd_cd AS settlement,p.use_yn FROM prj.prj p
mapper.select: SELECT s.bill_stg_id AS stage_id,s.prj_id AS project_id,s.sply_amt,s.bill_plan_dt AS planned FROM prj.bill_stg s WHERE s.bill_stg_id=#{id}

SELECT a.asgn_id,a.dev_id,coalesce(a.cntrct_dev_id,a.dev_id) AS cntrct_dev_id, d.dev_nm AS display_name,v.mng_no AS management_number,a.asgn_se_cd AS kind,a.bgn_dt, m.mm_qty,u.bill_untprc_amt AS price,t.atnd_id AS attendance_id,t.work_day_qty, t.rglr_tm_qty AS regular_hours,t.ovtm_tm_qty AS overtime_hours,t.mth_work_day_qty AS month_work_days FROM asgn.asgn a JOIN mst.dev v ON v.dev_id=a.dev_id JOIN mst.dev d ON d.dev_id=coalesce(a.cntrct_dev_id,a.dev_id) LEFT JOIN asgn.asgn_mth m ON m.asgn_id=a.asgn_id AND m.work_ym=#{month} LEFT JOIN bill.dspch_atnd t ON t.asgn_id=a.asgn_id AND t.work_ym=#{month} LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT h.bill_untprc_amt FROM asgn.untprc_hist h WHERE h.asgn_id=a.asgn_id AND h.aply_bgn_dt <= greatest((#{month}||'-01')::date,a.bgn_dt) ORDER BY h.aply_bgn_dt DESC LIMIT 1) u ON true WHERE a.prj_id=#{projectId} AND a.asgn_stts_cd!='CANCELLED' AND a.bgn_dt < (#{month}||'-01')::date+interval '1 month' AND a.end_dt >= (#{month}||'-01')::date ORDER BY a.asgn_id

WHERE p.use_yn='Y' AND p.cntrct_ty_cd IN ('MO','DP') AND ( EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM asgn.asgn a WHERE a.prj_id=p.prj_id AND a.asgn_stts_cd!='CANCELLED' AND a.bgn_dt < (#{month}||'-01')::date+interval '1 month' AND a.end_dt >= (#{month}||'-01')::date) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bill.bill b WHERE b.prj_id=p.prj_id AND b.atrb_ym=#{month} AND b.bill_stts_cd='CONFIRM')) ORDER BY p.prj_id
SELECT b.bill_id FROM bill.bill b WHERE b.prj_id=#{projectId} AND b.atrb_ym=#{month} AND b.bill_stts_cd='CONFIRM' ORDER BY b.bill_id
SELECT max(c.cls_ym) FROM fin.mth_cls c WHERE c.cls_stts_cd='CLOSED'
WHERE b.amnd_yn='N' AND b.bill_stts_cd='CONFIRM' AND CASE WHEN p.cntrct_ty_cd='TK' THEN to_char(b.bill_dt,'YYYY-MM') ELSE b.atrb_ym END BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} ORDER BY b.bill_id

SELECT p.bsn_part_nm AS name,p.hq_yn FROM prj.prj_part_hist h LEFT JOIN mst.bsn_part p ON p.bsn_part_id=h.bsn_part_id WHERE h.prj_id=#{projectId} AND h.aply_bgn_ym <= #{month} ORDER BY h.aply_bgn_ym DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT coalesce(sum(b.sply_amt),0)::bigint FROM bill.bill b JOIN prj.prj p ON p.prj_id=b.prj_id LEFT JOIN prj.bill_stg s ON s.bill_stg_id=b.bill_stg_id WHERE b.bill_stts_cd='DRAFT' AND CASE WHEN p.cntrct_ty_cd='TK' THEN to_char(coalesce(b.bill_dt,s.bill_plan_dt,b.created_at::date),'YYYY-MM') ELSE b.atrb_ym END BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to}

SELECT (coalesce((SELECT sum(b.sply_amt) FROM bill.bill b JOIN prj.prj p ON p.prj_id=b.prj_id WHERE b.bill_stts_cd='PLAN' AND CASE WHEN p.cntrct_ty_cd='TK' THEN to_char(coalesce(b.bill_dt,b.created_at::date),'YYYY-MM') ELSE b.atrb_ym END BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to}),0)+coalesce((SELECT sum(s.sply_amt) FROM prj.bill_stg s JOIN prj.prj p ON p.prj_id=s.prj_id WHERE p.cntrct_ty_cd='TK' AND to_char(coalesce(s.bill_plan_dt,s.created_at::date),'YYYY-MM') BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bill.bill b WHERE b.bill_stg_id=s.bill_stg_id AND b.bill_stts_cd!='CANCEL')),0))::bigint
